title: Spatial Relationship & Infrastructure Graph Relationship Registry

relationships.title: Spatially Intersects
relationships.description: Source and target WGS84 bounding boxes intersect under v4.47 bounding-box semantics.

relationships.title: Co-located With
relationships.description: Source and target share the same canonical WGS84 bounding box.

relationships.title: Connected To
relationships.description: Caller-asserted physical, operational, or logical connectivity.

relationships.title: Depends On
relationships.description: Source depends on target for operation, service, material, energy, data, or access.

relationships.title: Supplies
relationships.description: Source supplies energy, material, water, data, capacity, or another resource to target.

relationships.title: Serves
relationships.description: Source provides a service to target.

relationships.title: Upstream Of
relationships.description: Source is upstream of target in a physical, network, material, energy, or dependency flow.

relationships.title: Downstream Of
relationships.description: Source is downstream of target in a physical, network, material, energy, or dependency flow.

relationships.title: Part Of
relationships.description: Source is a constituent or component of target.

relationships.title: Exposed To
relationships.description: Source is exposed to a hazard, event, condition, or external influence represented by target.

relationships.title: Monitors
relationships.description: Source observes, senses, or monitors target.

relationships.title: Adjacent To
relationships.description: Caller-asserted adjacency where exact topology or distance is supplied externally.
